This records assistant-applied acceptance under human delegation, not individual human review of each payload.

evidence.interpretation: The assistant applies the recommended options and accepts exact naming payloads below under the supplied delegation. No per-convention user quotation, signed approval, native review receipt or independent reviewer is asserted. Owner review may revise these choices, requiring a new scoped record.

inputs.role: Historical unapproved extraction only; stale GaugeGroup rings candidate is superseded by direct draft extraction
Six recommended after-payloads adopted exactly under delegation, not prior consent evidence

draftSnapshot.method: Read current Markdown drafts excluding BRIEF.md; parse JSON fences, coalesce identical semantic IDs, compare definitions and canonical names/aliases. 60 unique payloads include one existing layout-orientation amendment, leaving 59 new IDs. Whole-file hashes identify inputs, not approval of entire component specs or visual/runtime verification.
draftSnapshot.gaugeGroup: items / collection-items is reused verbatim; independent-gauge-rings is excluded, not renamed into an alias. Ring measurement fields remain per entry; center is shared decorative content.

limits: Assistant-observed human delegation, not provider-native, signed, independent or per-payload human approval. Hashes bind content only and cannot prove consent.

Naming acceptance only: no exact-snapshot component approval, implementation plan, Material recipe, geometry sharing, private Gauge refactor, token/dependency change, API migration or runtime compatibility is authorized.
New entries have usages []; existing implementation usages, types and whole-file source revisions are retained verbatim. Planned types.ts files are not implementation evidence.

Native/Radix attributes and unrelated local schema keys are not mass-registered. selection-cardinality/type does not cover native type or NavList branch discriminators; menu-entry-kind/kind remains menu-specific. UserMenu recipe adds no owned prop usages.

Prior receipts are immutable history. The six amended entries point here for their new content; unchanged entries retain prior approvals. surface-elevation is no longer deferred because Surface now exposes that axis.
Drafts and earlier extraction artifacts remain unchanged. The tracked entries below are the recoverable exact naming snapshot even when local ignored drafts are unavailable.
Captures, browser/AT/runtime checks, GitHub publication, PR creation and terminal git delivery remain outside this consolidation unit. No such success is claimed.

semanticAmendments.boundary: Gauge/GaugeGroup independent passive meter conditions only; retain normal/warning/critical/muted and conditional stateText. No lifecycle/selection state, aggregate severity, threshold inference, progress or loading.
Visible per-meter non-color condition text; retain string/conditional requiredness, no live/group status, naming or numeric-equivalent substitution.

Gauge center or GaugeGroup shared innermost hole, decorative ReactNode only; no actions, focus, sole meaning or Group aggregate. Group suppresses center when all readings unavailable; Gauge unchanged.

Share coherent normalized value text, not roles or algorithms: Gauge/GaugeGroup finite magnitudes are meters with X / 100 defaults; ProgressBar #65/MeterRow are task progressbars with percent/coherent text. Non-finite magnitudes are unavailable, non-finite task progress is indeterminate and suppresses finite valueText. No remote #65 edit or atom-contract approval.

Unavailable numeric/remaining-time displays expose no value. Preserve component-specific invalid policies and defaults. Countdown invalid deadline has no timer or zero; initializingText is first sampling and expiredText accompanies genuine zero. Never use this fallback for indeterminate task progress.

Interactive collection navigation axis or passive Radix separator orientation only. Divider remains horizontal/vertical with independent decorative semantics and no arrow navigation. Stack/Cluster visual flow and native dir are excluded.

convention.name: elevation
convention.meaning: The elevation treatment of a material surface.
convention.whenToUse: A surface exposes a supported elevation axis.
convention.avoid: Condition, dimensions or an arbitrary shadow value.

convention.name: state
convention.meaning: The consumer-selected interpretation of a Gauge magnitude or an independent GaugeGroup ring magnitude, independent of thresholds.
convention.whenToUse: A Gauge or GaugeGroup ring exposes consumer-selected normal, warning, critical or muted measurement conditions.
convention.avoid: Visual variants, material tone, loading behavior or automatic threshold inference.

convention.name: stateText
convention.meaning: Visible non-color text describing the selected condition of a Gauge magnitude or independent GaugeGroup ring.
convention.whenToUse: Supply condition text, required for non-normal Gauge or GaugeGroup ring states by their conditional unions.
convention.avoid: Replacing the accessible name or the numeric equivalent.

convention.name: valueText
convention.meaning: A contextual text equivalent of a normalized displayed magnitude or determinate task-progress value.
convention.whenToUse: A magnitude or task-progress display exposes a readable value equivalent coherent with its component-specific normalization.
convention.avoid: Condition text, accessible naming, incoherent raw out-of-range values, unavailable-data messages or indeterminate-progress feedback.

convention.name: center
convention.meaning: Optional decorative, non-interactive content inside a Gauge ring or GaugeGroup's shared innermost hole.
convention.whenToUse: Propose an icon, value or short text with meaning already represented accessibly.
convention.avoid: Actions, focusable descendants, a fixed logo or the sole source of meaning.

convention.name: unavailableText
convention.meaning: Readable fallback when a numeric or remaining-time display is unavailable and exposes no value.
convention.whenToUse: Propose non-empty unavailable-data text separately from invalid-input policy approval.
convention.avoid: Loading or initial clock sampling, disabled state, fabricated zero values, genuine expired zero time, indeterminate task progress or assuming fallback wording is approved.

convention.name: orientation
convention.meaning: Main axis of a component's items or of a semantic separator; an interactive collection's arrow-key navigation follows that axis.
convention.whenToUse: A collection's layout and keyboard model share an axis, or a passive separator exposes its horizontal or vertical semantic orientation.
convention.avoid: Purely visual direction changes in generic layout primitives, text direction (use dir), or inventing keyboard behavior for passive separators.

convention.name: ratio
convention.meaning: The width-to-height proportion of a reserved media or content region, independent of its rendered dimensions.
convention.whenToUse: A primitive or media component reserves proportional space; the component-specific type may be a numeric width divided by height or a documented set of format presets.
convention.avoid: Absolute width or height, image crop or object-fit policy, measurement values, or Material treatment.

convention.name: items
convention.meaning: Ordered data describing the entries a composite component renders, such as tabs, menu entries or navigation links; the entry shape is component-specific.
convention.whenToUse: A molecule renders its own standard entry, with its sub-parts, for each element of a consumer-supplied list.
convention.avoid: Selectable form options (use choice-options/options), free composition through children, or ReactNode lists without a defined entry shape.

convention.name: messages
convention.meaning: Component-specific dictionary of localizable built-in interface text and text formatters, with documented defaults for omitted entries.
convention.whenToUse: A composite component owns several related control labels, instructions or announcements that consumers need to translate together.
convention.avoid: User-authored content, the component's primary accessible name (use label), styling, behavior configuration or a global translation provider.

convention.name: type
convention.meaning: Whether a value-selection group allows at most one selected option or multiple selected options.
convention.whenToUse: A group explicitly supports single and multiple selection, with string and string-array value APIs respectively.
convention.avoid: Native button or input type attributes, visual treatments (use variant), boolean pressed state or requiring a form selection.

convention.name: deadline
convention.meaning: Absolute instant at which a countdown reaches zero, expressed as Unix epoch milliseconds.
convention.whenToUse: A time-based display counts down to one consumer-supplied instant with component-specific validity bounds.
convention.avoid: Durations, local calendar strings without timezone resolution, animation timing, task progress or automatic server-clock synchronization.

convention.name: deadlineText
convention.meaning: Human-readable date, time and timezone describing the absolute deadline independently of the changing remaining duration.
convention.whenToUse: A countdown supplies persistent readable context for its target instant and consumers own localization and timezone wording.
convention.avoid: The current numeric remainder, timer accessible name, expired messages, unverified event-start claims or automatic locale parsing.

convention.name: units
convention.meaning: Ordered localized labels for the day, hour, minute and second columns of a remaining-time display.
convention.whenToUse: A countdown renders a fixed four-unit breakdown and consumers provide short unit names or abbreviations.
convention.avoid: Measurement units of unrelated figures, duration values, arbitrary item collections or assuming grammatical pluralization is automatic.

convention.name: onExpire
convention.meaning: Notification that the client observed a countdown deadline reached, receiving the expired instant in Unix epoch milliseconds.
convention.whenToUse: A countdown reports expiration with an explicit component-specific episode and remount policy so consumers can react or announce separately.
convention.avoid: Per-second ticks, user-driven value changes, callbacks during render or SSR, authoritative event-start signals or cross-instance exactly-once guarantees.

convention.name: initializingText
convention.meaning: Readable placeholder while a time-based display has not yet sampled its client clock.
convention.whenToUse: A countdown deliberately renders deterministic server and initial hydration content before starting its client clock.
convention.avoid: Invalid or missing measurements (use unavailableText), loading controls, fabricated zero time or automatically announced status.

convention.name: expiredText
convention.meaning: Visible text explaining that a countdown's target instant has been reached.
convention.whenToUse: A countdown retains a genuine zero readout and adds a localizable non-live expiration explanation.
convention.avoid: Assuming an event is live or completed, invalid-input messages, automatic announcements or the remaining duration itself.

convention.name: decorative
convention.meaning: Whether a passive separator is visual decoration rather than a meaningful content boundary exposed to assistive technology.
convention.whenToUse: A separator supports both decorative use beside text and semantic use between content regions without changing its paint.
convention.avoid: Hiding meaningful content, naming controls, interactive window splitters, visibility toggles or changing focus behavior.

convention.name: hint
convention.meaning: Muted help text shown with a form control and linked to it as its description.
convention.whenToUse: A labelled form control needs persistent guidance such as format, consequences or limits.
convention.avoid: Error messages (use error), accessible names, placeholders or long documentation.

convention.name: error
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied validation message that marks the form control invalid and is linked to it as its description.
convention.whenToUse: A form control's current value fails validation and the consumer explains why in text.
convention.avoid: Validation logic, status tones of non-form components, toasts or page-level alerts.

convention.name: counter
convention.meaning: Current length and maximum length of a text control, shown as a visible counter that changes tone when exceeded.
convention.whenToUse: A text field has a length limit the user should see while typing.
convention.avoid: Item counts, badges, numeric values of non-text controls, or replacing the error message.

convention.name: readout
convention.meaning: Visible text of a control's current value shown next to its label in an output element linked to the control.
convention.whenToUse: A control whose value is not readable on the control itself, such as a slider, shows its formatted value.
convention.avoid: Accessible value text (use the control's own value text), counters, hints or editable values.

convention.name: hideLabel
convention.meaning: Hides a required visible label visually while keeping it in the accessibility tree as the control's name.
convention.whenToUse: The surrounding layout already makes the purpose obvious, such as a search box in a toolbar.
convention.avoid: Omitting the label, icon-only buttons (use their label prop) or hiding hints and errors.

convention.name: layout
convention.meaning: Arrangement of a control and its label: label stacked above the control, or the control beside its label in one row.
convention.whenToUse: A wrapper places text fields with a stacked label and checkboxes or switches with an inline label.
convention.avoid: Item axes with keyboard navigation (use orientation), visual treatments (use variant) or page layout.

convention.name: align
convention.meaning: Alignment of floating content along the chosen side of its trigger (start, center or end) before collision handling.
convention.whenToUse: A floating component such as a menu or popover lets the consumer line its panel up with the trigger's start, center or end edge.
convention.avoid: Text alignment, layout alignment of in-flow content, or choosing the side (use floating-side/side).

convention.name: open
convention.meaning: Controlled visibility of a component's disclosed, floating or transient content, such as a collapsible group, panel or notification.
convention.whenToUse: A component lets the consumer control whether its disclosed, floating or transient content is shown, together with onOpenChange.
convention.avoid: Selection, pressed or checked state (use value, pressed or checked), or content that is always visible.

convention.name: defaultOpen
convention.meaning: Initial visibility of an uncontrolled disclosure, floating or transient component.
convention.whenToUse: A component supports uncontrolled initialization alongside the open prop; its initial default is component-specific.
convention.avoid: Controlled-only components or initial selection values (use defaultValue).

convention.name: onOpenChange
convention.meaning: Notification requesting the next boolean open state after a supported user interaction or component-owned timer.
convention.whenToUse: A disclosure, floating or transient component reports visibility requests from triggers, focus/hover delays, Escape, outside interaction, selection or auto-dismissal.
convention.avoid: Incoming prop updates, initial mounting, value or selection changes (use onValueChange), and pressed or checked changes.

convention.name: status
convention.meaning: Consumer-selected lifecycle or availability presentation of a content item, expressed through data-state and accompanied by readable status content.
convention.whenToUse: A content item or card represents a default, newly added, failed, completed, empty, dragged or inactive entity without owning its domain transitions.
convention.avoid: Gauge magnitude interpretation (use state), material or semantic color families (use tone), selection, pressed state, disabled controls, or automatic domain state machines.

convention.name: kind
convention.meaning: The semantic role of an entry in a data-driven menu: action, destination link, separator, group label or submenu.
convention.whenToUse: Menu exposes a discriminated public entry schema and selects the corresponding Radix menu part from each entry's role; recipe consumers reuse the same schema.
convention.avoid: Selection cardinality (use type), native button or input type attributes, Radix-provided props, visual treatments or changing an action into a selectable form option.

convention.name: header
convention.meaning: Non-interactive content shown at the top of a floating panel, above and separated from its entries.
convention.whenToUse: A menu or panel shows identity or context, such as the signed-in user, before its entries.
convention.avoid: Interactive controls, page or section headings, or text that is the panel's only accessible name.

convention.name: onNavigate
convention.meaning: Notification that the user activated a link entry rendered by the component, with the entry and the originating event; preventing the event's default lets a client-side router handle the navigation.
convention.whenToUse: A component renders anchors from data, such as menus or navigation lists, and single-page apps must intercept navigation.
convention.avoid: Action entries without a destination (use the entry's onSelect), form submission, or notifications of route changes that did not come from the user.

convention.name: help
convention.meaning: Persistent plain-text guidance or context describing a non-interactive numeric display, linked to its semantic indicator when one is present.
convention.whenToUse: A row combines a named progress or magnitude display with a visible supporting explanation of what it represents or how to interpret it.
convention.avoid: Form-control hints (use hint), accessible names, numeric value equivalents (use valueText), short change deltas, errors, tooltips or interactive help content.

convention.name: title
convention.meaning: Visible primary heading text identifying a page, section or content unit.
convention.whenToUse: A composite component owns a distinct heading slot and renders the supplied text with native heading semantics.
convention.avoid: Native title tooltips, accessible names of controls (use label), status-message lead sentences (use summary), or arbitrary rich content.

convention.name: level
convention.meaning: Native semantic rank of a rendered heading, independent of its visual typography.
convention.whenToUse: A heading or heading-owning composition lets the consumer select the appropriate h1 through h6 rank for the document outline.
convention.avoid: Typography size, visual register, indentation, surface elevation or changing semantics solely for appearance.

convention.name: actions
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied action elements (buttons or links) rendered in a component's trailing action area.
convention.whenToUse: A message, header or control bar offers one or two related actions that the consumer builds with system Button or Link components.
convention.avoid: Primary navigation, generating buttons from data inside the component, or arbitrary layout content unrelated to actions.

convention.name: footer
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied supplementary metadata and optional utility control rendered after a panel's main content and primary actions.
convention.whenToUse: A card or panel offers a distinct lower area for context such as last-updated text and a refresh action, optionally on a lower tonal band.
convention.avoid: Primary action collections (use actions), page or site footers, navigation, arbitrary replacement of the body, or a consumer-defined Material recipe.

convention.name: summary
convention.meaning: Short required lead sentence of a status message, shown first and emphasized, that states the situation in words.
convention.whenToUse: A notice or toast needs a keyword sentence that carries its meaning without relying on color, followed by optional detail.
convention.avoid: Accessible names of controls, headings of page sections, long descriptions, or native title tooltips.

convention.name: eyebrow
convention.meaning: Short contextual text rendered before a component's primary heading.
convention.whenToUse: A header composition offers an optional context line above its title.
convention.avoid: The primary heading, an accessible name, status text, metadata collections or descriptions below the heading.

convention.name: imageCaption
convention.meaning: Optional plain-text caption associated with one image figure, providing context or accurately supplied credit separately from the image's alternative text.
convention.whenToUse: An image composition owns a native figcaption accompanying its media; the caption is not a replacement for descriptive alt text.
convention.avoid: Collection captions (use caption), accessible names of controls, generated attribution, unsupported license assertions, interactive content or automatic duplication of alt text.

convention.name: focalPoint
convention.meaning: A supported alignment preset that selects which area of a cover-cropped image is prioritized within its reserved viewport.
convention.whenToUse: A media component exposes a finite set of static object-position choices independently of its aspect ratio and rendered dimensions.
convention.avoid: Absolute positioning, arbitrary inline CSS coordinates, image size/ratio, layout alignment, material tone or pointer-tracking effects.

convention.name: modal
convention.meaning: Whether an open floating dialog restricts focus, assistive-technology access and pointer interaction to its own content instead of allowing interaction with the surrounding page.
convention.whenToUse: A floating dialog supports both non-modal and modal interaction through its underlying Radix primitive; the component defines dismissal and focus restoration separately.
convention.avoid: A visual scrim, a guarantee that a workflow cannot be dismissed, overlay elevation, or custom implementations of focus trapping and outside-interaction blocking.

convention.name: container
convention.meaning: The DOM node that a component's portalled content is rendered into instead of the document body.
convention.whenToUse: A component renders layered or floating content through a portal and the consumer may need another mount node, such as a shadow root, an iframe body or a subtree that scopes theme tokens.
convention.avoid: Layout wrappers, collision or positioning boundaries for floating content, or choosing which element a component renders as (use asChild).

convention.name: accent
convention.meaning: One optional trailing text run visually emphasized within a display phrase while remaining part of its readable content.
convention.whenToUse: Display typography offers a highlighted ending or punctuation after its main children.
convention.avoid: Accessible names, status messages, arbitrary rich slots, interactive children or hiding meaningful text from assistive technology.

convention.name: text
convention.meaning: Main plain-text passage reproduced as a quotation, excluding separate attribution and optional trailing accent text.
convention.whenToUse: A quotation composition renders the consumer's passage inside native blockquote semantics without accepting rich content.
convention.avoid: Generic children, heading titles, accessible names, HTML strings intended for injection, source captions or automatically generated quotations.

convention.name: source
convention.meaning: Visible attribution or contextual source caption accompanying a quotation, outside the quoted passage.
convention.whenToUse: A quote composition exposes a plain-text figcaption for consumer-supplied attribution or contextual commentary.
convention.avoid: The quotation itself, native cite URL metadata, assuming a person's name is a work title, verified provenance claims or automatic source links.

convention.name: shortcut
convention.meaning: Display-only text showing a keyboard combination associated with an action; it does not register or parse a binding.
convention.whenToUse: A launcher or menu entry shows a passive Kbd hint for a shortcut registered by its host application.
convention.avoid: Global key listeners, platform detection, accessible-name replacement or treating display glyphs as aria-keyshortcuts syntax.

convention.name: compact
convention.meaning: Shows the compact icon-only presentation of a labelled launcher while retaining its accessible name and activation behavior.
convention.whenToUse: A launcher in a narrow toolbar hides its visible text and supplementary keyboard hint without changing its responsibility.
convention.avoid: Changing control semantics, arbitrary size presets, automatic responsive detection or removing the accessible name.

convention.name: accentBreak
convention.meaning: Whether the component's trailing text accent begins on a separate visual line.
convention.whenToUse: Display typography exposes a trailing text accent that may be block or inline without changing its semantic meaning.
convention.avoid: Automatic text splitting, truncation, extra accessible content or controlling arbitrary child layout.

convention.name: lede
convention.meaning: Optional introductory paragraph accompanying a section heading.
convention.whenToUse: An editorial header composition offers short introductory copy beneath or beside its primary heading.
convention.avoid: Accessible names, form hints, status-message summaries, heading text, arbitrary rich blocks or whole-section body content.

convention.name: titleId
convention.meaning: Consumer-supplied DOM ID of a composite component's heading, distinct from the composite root's native id.
convention.whenToUse: A heading-owning composition lets an enclosing section or other external element reference its internal heading with aria-labelledby.
convention.avoid: Styling selectors, root element IDs, shared literal IDs across instances, accessible-name text or arbitrary internal-part IDs.

convention.name: meta
convention.meaning: Short visible supplementary detail about an option, rendered below its label and available as its accessible description.
convention.whenToUse: A visual choice needs a secondary fact such as layer count, dimensions or duration to distinguish options.
convention.avoid: The option's accessible name, form instructions, numeric figure context, badges or long content.

convention.name: thumb
convention.meaning: Decorative preview image data for a selectable option whose identity is already supplied by its visible label.
convention.whenToUse: A visual choice includes a cropped preview to help sighted users recognize the option.
convention.avoid: User avatars, meaningful standalone images, editable media, video controls or the only source of option identity.

convention.name: live
convention.meaning: Marks the represented option as currently on air, independently of whether it is selected, with a required readable live-state annotation.
convention.whenToUse: A scene or media choice distinguishes the currently broadcast output from a preview selection.
convention.avoid: Selection state, loading, a generic status tone, live-region announcements or automatic broadcast activation.

convention.name: badge
convention.meaning: Short non-interactive text annotation over a thumbnail, rendered as a Badge and included in the option's accessible description.
convention.whenToUse: A visual option needs an overlaid state annotation such as Live, independently of its name and selection.
convention.avoid: Numeric counters, interactive actions, corner icon glyphs or replacing the option label.

convention.name: gap
convention.meaning: Token-backed spacing between adjacent children of a layout container, including row and column gaps when it wraps.
convention.whenToUse: A reusable layout container exposes a finite set of spacing-token keys or presets for space between its children.
convention.avoid: Inner padding (use padding), outer margins, arbitrary CSS lengths or changing the children's order.

convention.name: caption
convention.meaning: Optional visible contextual text accompanying a grouped collection, distinct from its accessible-name input.
convention.whenToUse: A collection composition offers a short visible caption that may be omitted without leaving the collection unnamed.
convention.avoid: Accessible naming (use label), heading eyebrows, image-specific attribution, long descriptions or item labels.

convention.name: inline
convention.meaning: Whether a collection's visible caption and its content share a wrapping row instead of being stacked vertically.
convention.whenToUse: A captioned collection supports the same content arranged beside or below its caption without changing interaction semantics.
convention.avoid: Keyboard navigation axes, CSS display:inline, inline prose links, field label layout or arbitrary orientation/reordering.

convention.name: alignItems
convention.meaning: Alignment of a layout container's children along its cross axis.
convention.whenToUse: A flex or grid layout container exposes supported item alignment choices such as start, center, end, stretch or baseline.
convention.avoid: Floating-panel alignment (use align), main-axis distribution (use justifyContent), text alignment or individual-child positioning.

convention.name: justifyContent
convention.meaning: Distribution of a layout container's children along its main axis when free space is available.
convention.whenToUse: A reusable layout container exposes supported distribution choices such as start, center, end or between.
convention.avoid: Cross-axis item alignment (use alignItems), floating-panel placement, text alignment or changing DOM order.

convention.name: padding
convention.meaning: Preset inner spacing between a container's edge and its content, mapped to spacing tokens.
convention.whenToUse: A container primitive such as Surface offers a few token-backed padding presets, including none for edge-to-edge content.
convention.avoid: Gaps between children (use gap), outer margins, arbitrary lengths or per-side overrides.

convention.name: radius
convention.meaning: Preset corner radius of a container, mapped to radius tokens.
convention.whenToUse: A container primitive offers token-backed corner presets, such as none for bands inside a panel or full for pills.
convention.avoid: Arbitrary lengths, per-corner overrides or shape changes that alter the component's meaning.

convention.name: duration
convention.meaning: Time in milliseconds a transient component stays visible before dismissing itself; Infinity disables auto-dismissal.
convention.whenToUse: A notification or similar transient element closes automatically after a consumer-adjustable time.
convention.avoid: Animation or transition durations, countdown targets, polling intervals or media lengths.

convention.name: dismissLabel
convention.meaning: Localizable accessible name of a component's built-in close or dismiss control.
convention.whenToUse: A component renders its own icon-only dismiss control and consumers must be able to translate its name.
convention.avoid: The accessible name of the component itself, visible button text supplied by consumers, or destructive actions.

convention.name: actionAltText
convention.meaning: Text describing how to perform a transient component's action through another, persistent route.
convention.whenToUse: A transient notification offers an action that may disappear before assistive-technology users reach it (Radix Toast Action altText).
convention.avoid: The visible action label, image alt text or accessible names of persistent controls.

convention.name: announcementLabel
convention.meaning: Localizable prefix that assistive technology announces before the content of each transient notification.
convention.whenToUse: A notification system announces messages through a live region and lets consumers translate the category word.
convention.avoid: Region or landmark names (use label), message text, or visible headings.
